subject.title: Redesign Overview as an operator-first OpenClaw dashboard

question: Should this PR become the canonical connected Overview/operator dashboard direction, or should maintainers prefer the overlapping #77774 path and extract only selected provider-usage pieces?
rationale: Both PRs redesign the same Overview surface, and automation cannot choose the desired product direction or accept fixture-only OpenRouter proof for a credential-backed feature.

options.title: Pick Canonical Dashboard Direction
options.body: Choose one Overview redesign as canonical, then require the selected branch to carry the provider-usage fixes and proof before merge.

options.title: Extract Provider Usage Only
options.body: Close or pause the full redesign and move the OpenRouter/provider-native quota pieces into a narrower PR after the auth-provider blockers are fixed.

options.title: Continue This PR As-Is
options.body: Maintainers could keep this branch as the direction, but it should remain blocked until proof and cache/enrollment defects are fixed.

recommendation.title: Pick Canonical Dashboard Direction
recommendation.body: Choose one Overview redesign as canonical, then require the selected branch to carry the provider-usage fixes and proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The overlapping Overview PR and provider/plugin history make this the best available owner signal for the product-direction choice.
